verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI runs agents on cron schedules through the hub. The docs say these scheduled agents persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session, for recurring jobs like daily summaries and code reviews. That is backed by fully headless automation for CI/CD and GitHub Actions/GitLab pipelines, auto-approve/YOLO modes for unattended execution, and scheduled routines in the native app. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled background runs work as documented.
